text:
Sarah L: Morning team — quick queue snapshot: total 72 (up 8 vs yesterday morning), P1: 1 (billing webhook delay), P2: 4 (2 embeddings rate-limit, 1 model mismatch, 1 auth token). Known issues: embeddings regression seen in last 12h. Planning to update macros for billing webhook retry. Any blockers or hot takes?

James H: I can take the billing P1. pinging eng-oncall for logs and recent deploys. :point_up:

eng-oncall: Looking. Last deploy for billing-worker was 2456788800. Checking logs now.

Priya K: On embeddings — observed increased 429s after the quantization PR. I have a small PR to add throttling and exponential backoff. Need a quick review in #repo-embeddings, tagging @MarcoT for review.

Marco T: Reviewing now, will approve if tests pass. Also suggest adding a quick macro to advise customers to retry with jitter rather than immediate retries.

support-bot: Created ticket IN-1242 for billing webhook P1 and linked the customer request.

Sarah L: Macro draft (please copy into macros manager):
```text
Title: Billing webhook timeout & retry
Steps:
 1) Verify webhook endpoint reachable
 2) If 504/timeout -> Increase timeout to 30s then retry up to 2x with exponential backoff
 3) If still fails, escalate to engineering oncall with logs attached
Note: We've seen transient timeouts after recent deploy; ask customer to retry after 5m if still failing.
```
Can someone paste this into macros and link back?

James H: I'll add it to macros and link here shortly.

James H: Added macro: billing-webhook-retry -> internal link: https://redwood.internal/macros/billing-webhook-retry 

Priya K: For embeddings, immediate workaround for customers: switch to model `embed-lite-v1` until regression is fixed. I'll file the bug and aim for a fix in the next deploy.

Marco T: Also recommend enabling temporary 'ticket-hold' for high-rate users to reduce noise while we stabilize embeddings. Ops can toggle per-customer.

Sarah L: Thanks all. My blockers: none besides waiting on eng logs. Today: take billing P1 to resolution, push macro update, merge Priya's throttling PR, and monitor queue. If anyone needs a handoff for evening shift, ping me.

eng-oncall: Found spike in billing-worker latencies — looks tied to DB connection pool saturation post-deploy. Rolling a config bump to pool_size=50; will monitor for 15m.

Sarah L: :thumbsup: keep me posted on whether the pool bump stabilizes the webhook timeouts.
